WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
web AS (
    SELECT business_date, SUM(net_sales) AS ns FROM net_lines WHERE store_id = 900 GROUP BY 1
),
ctl AS (
    SELECT business_date, SUM(net_sales) AS cs FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id = 900 GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, ROUND(SUM(w.ns),2) AS web_net_sales, ROUND(SUM(c.cs),2) AS control, COUNT(DISTINCT d.calendar_date) AS days, MIN(d.calendar_date) AS dmin, MAX(d.calendar_date) AS dmax
FROM dim_date d LEFT JOIN web w ON w.business_date = d.calendar_date LEFT JOIN ctl c ON c.business_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 2

SELECT 'sales_dup_line_id' AS chk, COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS n FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
UNION ALL SELECT 'sales_dup_receipt_line', COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
UNION ALL SELECT 'return_dup_id', COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT return_line_id) FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
UNION ALL SELECT 'web_order_dup', COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) FROM fact_web_order
UNION ALL SELECT 'web_lines_no_dispatch', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id AND o.status IN ('delivered','collected') WHERE s.store_id=900 AND o.web_order_id IS NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'web_test_lines_in_range', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category='ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-12-21'
UNION ALL SELECT 'ret_not_in_sales', COUNT(*) FROM fact_return_line r LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id WHERE f.sales_line_id IS NULL

WITH d AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no, COUNT(*) c FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31' GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1
)
SELECT s.store_id, f.channel_code, COUNT(*) AS rows_in_dups, COUNT(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS keys,
  MIN(f.sale_date) mn, MAX(f.sale_date) mx, COUNT(DISTINCT f.etl_loaded_at) AS loads, SUM(f.net_amount) AS net
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN d ON d.receipt_id=f.receipt_id AND d.line_no=f.line_no JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
